title: Reducing Arterial Inflammation Using Eplerenone and Statins in HIV
official: Study to Understand the Reduction in Arterial Inflammation Combining Statins and Eplerenone
summary: HIV has transitioned to a chronic disease in which well-treated persons remain at higher risk for heart disease when compared to the general population. Statin medications have been shown to reduce the number of events related to heart disease, but there are still individuals who will have complications from heart disease despite statin use. This study is being conducted to determine whether adding on another medication to statins called eplerenone, which has been shown to reduce inflammation in the heart vasculature among persons with HIV, can further decrease the risk of heart disease in HIV through its anti-inflammatory and blood pressure-lowering potential.

sites.f: UCLA Center for Clinical AIDS Research and Education (CARE)
